product_from_film: Rainbrand promises shared brand context so agents can create work that fits a brand.
explains_well: Repeated chat corrections show the pain of wrong logos, fonts and generic output.
unclear: No working Rainbrand setup or corrected agent output is demonstrated.
scenario: Ask an agent for a launch campaign, receive mismatched designs, and seek shared brand context.
product_clear_basis: The poster at 46s says one brand is shared with every agent; the next card promises on-brand work.

closer_windows.resolved: 12 frames at 36.00–38.75s show text entry, a brief distressed-person shot at 37s, then multiplying error windows and a return to the desk. Exact sub-frame edits and easing unverified.

categories.finding: Abstract montage precedes a launch-campaign chat that fails; a consistent identity system is offered as the answer.
A dark body silhouette and vivid flowing color fill 0–2s. This establishes visual energy but no task or product.
The user is someone making branded work with agents. The task starts at 27s; the shared-brand product promise is clear at 46s.
The central square anchors changing imagery. Later, typed chat grows and error windows accumulate. Dense 36–39s samples support the accumulation, not exact easing.
A black interval around 41s separates failure from brand reveal. At 37s a brief person insert interrupts the chat; by 37.25s the screen returns.
Neon distortions give way to a warm retro desk, then noisy monochrome failure and clean branded packaging.
Chat sentences carry the problem; the six outputs show mismatch. The final descriptor carries the product definition.
The inspected ASR draft provides partial script-role support; recognition limits are recorded in A02. Audible voice characteristics and delivery remain unchecked.
categories.reason: Local draft text was read; no direct listening.

categories.finding: The written corrections explain the failure without sound. The solution depends on short statements, because no new workflow is shown.
A fixed central square holds the eye through the opening changes. Chat left and result grid right create a clear request/result comparison later.
The opening provides many textures before any task. The readable problem begins only after 23s.
categories.experiment: Test a cut that opens on the first wrong-brand campaign.

categories.finding: The opening promises a visual identity experience; the consistent Rainbrand mockups pay that off. The chat problem receives a promise rather than a demonstrated fix.
Frustration is suggested by corrections, a person holding their face and repeated errors. The clean identity reveal suggests relief; no audience response is measured.
categories.reason: Emotional meaning is an interpretation of visible states.

categories.finding: The square motif connects the abstract montage to the later brand. The same campaign task is lost when the film switches to packaging.
The failed chat is staged evidence of a problem. Consistent Rainbrand assets show an identity, but do not prove agents shared context to create it.
Orange-blue liquid shapes, the small square and the repeated bold wordmark form a distinct identity system.
The wrong-logo and wrong-font corrections explain the pain directly. Much of the first 23s could be shortened without losing that scenario.
For Tin, prepare one incorrect campaign and one corrected campaign under the same brief; use brand constraints as visible chat corrections.
categories.experiment: Replace the packaging reveal with the same six campaign slots corrected after brand context is added.

categories.finding: No human new-viewer test was performed.
categories.reason: The product summary is this model’s film-only reading.

categories.finding: Mobile preview and accessibility checks were not performed.
categories.reason: Contact sheets are evidence views, not a stated mobile preview or compliance test.

lessons.keep: Show wrong logo and wrong font as specific corrections beside the failed designs.
try: For Tin brand onboarding, show one campaign grid before and after adding the brand kit; retain the exact brief and six slots.
For a Tin opening, use a two-second wrong-logo correction followed immediately by the brand-context action, using actual prepared UI states.
lessons.avoid: A long visual montage that delays the user task and a solution reveal that abandons that task.
lessons.open: Actual shared-context behavior, audio, and most sub-second opening cuts are unverified.
